name: item
title: Item
description: A row in a list of like objects, with media, content, and actions.
docs: ## When to use - A list of comparable objects where each row carries a name, a line of supporting text, and an action: files, members, invoices, saved searches. - A row that must become a link as a whole, without nesting a button inside an anchor. - A dense list where three sizes (`default`, `sm`, `xs`) cover a panel, a card, and a sidebar strip respectively. ## When not to use - Tabular data with columns that need to line up across rows. Use `table`: an item is a sentence, not a grid. - A single object on its own page. Use `card`; the item's rhythm assumes siblings. - A selectable row inside a menu or a listbox. Those have their own roles and keyboard model; use the menu or `command` component. ## Installation ```bash npx shadcn@latest add @cadence/item ``` ## Usage ```tsx import { FileText } from "lucide-react"; import { Item, ItemContent, ItemDescription, ItemGroup, ItemMedia, ItemTitle, } from "@/components/cadence/item/item"; export function Files() { return ( parity-plan.md Edited 4 minutes ago by you. ); } ``` ## Examples ### A whole-row link `render` replaces the wrapper element (Base UI `render`, not `asChild`). The anchor keeps `data-slot="item"`, so CSS and `group/item` selectors still work. ```tsx }> plan.pdf 2.4 MB ``` ### Variants `default` is transparent, `outline` adds the border, `muted` fills the surface. The border is always present in the box model — only its colour changes — so switching variants never shifts the layout. ```tsx ``` ### Separators `ItemSeparator` is a horizontal `Separator` with the vertical margins removed, so it sits flush between rows. ```tsx … … ``` ### Header and footer `ItemHeader` and `ItemFooter` take a full row (`basis-full`), for metadata above the title or a progress line below the content. ```tsx Quarterly report Draft Updated 2h ago ``` ## API | Part | Props | Notes | | ----------------- | -------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- | | `Item` | `variant`, `size`, `render` | `variant`: `default \| outline \| muted`; `size`: `default \| sm \| xs`. | | `ItemGroup` | native div props | `role="list"`; wraps rows and separators. | | `ItemMedia` | `variant` | `default \| icon \| image`, exposed as `data-variant`. | | `ItemContent` | native div props | Grows; a second content block stops growing. | | `ItemTitle` | native div props | One line, medium weight. | | `ItemDescription` | native props for `p` | Clamped to two lines, muted. | | `ItemActions` | native div props | Right-aligned controls. | | `ItemHeader` | native div props | Full-width row above the content. | | `ItemFooter` | native div props | Full-width row below the content. | | `ItemSeparator` | `Separator` props | Horizontal rule with `my-0`. | `Item` writes `data-slot="item"`, `data-variant`, and `data-size`; the other parts write their own `data-slot` (`item-media`, `item-content`, `item-title`, `item-description`, `item-actions`, `item-header`, `item-footer`, `item-separator`). ## Motion contract No motion (T0). A row does not lift on hover or slide on mount. The only transition is `transition-colors` on the row and on a link inside it — state feedback that costs nothing and never moves the text the user is reading. | Phase | Properties | Token | Interruptible | | ------- | ---------- | ----- | ------------- | | – | none | – | – | | reduced | none | – | – | | none | none | – | – | If a list should arrive in sequence, that is `list.stagger` on the parent. A row that animates itself cannot be interrupted by the next render. ## Accessibility - `ItemGroup` sets `role="list"`. Rows are `div`s (or an anchor via `render`), so give the group a label when it is not already under a heading: `aria-label="Files"`. - A row that links nowhere is a container. If the whole row is clickable, render an anchor with `render` rather than adding `onClick` — the anchor is focusable, middle-clickable, and announced as a link. - `ItemMedia variant="icon"` is decorative in most rows; add `aria-label` to the icon only when it carries information the title does not. - Keep action buttons out of the tab order of a read-only list. Put them in `ItemActions` and reveal them on hover **and** focus, never hover alone. ## Notes for AI - Reach for `Item` when the row is a sentence about one object; reach for `table` when the columns are the point. - `size="sm"` and `xs` do not change type: they change padding and gaps. Use them for density, not hierarchy. - Use `ItemSeparator`, not `border-b` on the row: the separator keeps the variant border colour independent of the divider.
